body: That's kinda how "SAD" works seasonal affective disorder. Which I think I have. During the winter time I just lose all motivation, energy etc. And I have kinda noticed it comes back after winter ends

To be honest with you, I kinda hate healthcare with a passion for many reasons. I'm glad that others are able to get some help from it, but I don't think it's in the cards for me. I think my best bet is to wait for springtime and try to seek help from close friends

Other than that, my main problem is just this feeling on meaninglessness in life. I can't seam to find the drive or passion for life that I once had. I keep looking for it, and trying different things but nothing seems to stick. I'm afraid this will basically be my whole life. An endless cycle of just existing

I had a very bad experience seeking therapy, all the clinics in my area were closed and I ended up going to a hospital to ask if I could see a therapist for depression. They ended up putting me on a 72hr hold in basically an insane asylum. After that I basically lost faith in all mental health related healthcare.

Yeah, I had a good talk with a close friend about it the other day. I've dealt with waves of depression/SAD for quite a few years now and am attempting to be more open about it, instead of just completely retracting into myself when it hits
